lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of circular high-luminance spots are visible on the lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid-like distribution, with higher intensity clusters appearing in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal spot trajectories to form a structured, grid-like pattern across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights along the top edge and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller, high-luminance spots, particularly visible along its trailing edge.
